title: THE GEOMETRY OF DISTRIBUTED REPRESENTATIONS FOR BETTER ALIGNMENT, ATTENUATED BIAS, AND IMPROVED INTERPRETABILITY

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vector distances and analogies using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), Embedding Coherence Test (ECT), and Embedding Quality Test (EQT), as well as measuring invalid sentence entailments and contradictions in Natural Language Inference (NLI) tasks.
Using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to compare the vector associations of African-American, Hispanic, and European-American names with positive/negative connotations and occupations.
Using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to evaluate the associations of names popular in different eras (youth vs. aged) with positive and negative words.
Measuring the probability of invalid entailments or contradictions in Natural Language Inference (NLI) tasks when comparing sentences containing demonyms with those containing polarity terms.

Measuring the probability of invalid entailments or contradictions in Natural Language Inference (NLI) tasks when comparing sentences containing religious adherents with those containing polarity terms.
